items.title: Beyond Construction: The Platform Effect of Environmental Infrastructure in Carbon Capture and Storage
items.summary: Carbon capture and storage (CCS) remains one of the most capital-intensive clean energy investments in the United States. Despite its importance, regional science and environmental economics have paid limited attention to its economic effects. This study presents a comprehensive, replicable, multi-scalar framework based on IMPLAN to analyze the economic effects of a proposed CCS facility in a U.S. Gulf Coast county with a deep-water port. The framework examines four components: sequestration field construction, pipeline system development, annual operations, and on-site carbon capture installations. items.title: Road to clean skies: assessing the effects of low-carbon transport systems policy on monthly air pollution
items.authors: Jiali He, Jinxing Guo, Jingyi Meng, Lei Jiang
items.summary: The transportation sector is a major source of urban air pollution. Using county-level monthly panel data from China for 2007–2019, this paper evaluates two rounds of the low-carbon transport systems pilot policy introduced in 2011 and 2012 through a staggered difference-in-differences design. The fully controlled baseline specification indicates an approximately 2.1% reduction in monthly PM2.5 concentrations, statistically significant at the 5% level. Mechanism analyses provide evidence consistent with cleaner and more efficient energy use, changes in transportation structure, and expanded public transit as potential channels. items.title: Research on the Coordinated Development of Urban Green Infrastructure Construction and Carbon Neutrality
items.summary: This study systematically explores the intrinsic mechanism and implementation path of the coordinated development of urban green infrastructure (UGI) and carbon neutrality. Based on the four-dimensional analysis framework of input carbon effect synergy institutional guarantee, the contribution characteristics of UGI to carbon neutrality were revealed through remote sensing inversion, model simulation, and multiple case comparisons.
